Description: ByUs environment: immutable ECS web, optional RDS/PostgREST, private storage, Cognito and HTTPS CloudFront; DNS unchanged

OriginDomainName.Description: Pre-existing DNS name resolving to the public ALB and covered by the Seoul certificate.

InternalApiDomainName.Description: Private DNS name resolving to internal ALB, covered by the Seoul certificate.

RuntimeConfigSecretArn.Description: Existing Secrets Manager secret containing the complete runtime JSON; never put secret values in parameters.

WebCallbackUrls.Description: Registered https web OAuth callbacks; no wildcard.

MobileCallbackUrls.Description: App registered deep links / universal links.

Route53HostedZoneId.Description: Existing zone ID, informational only. This template does not create DNS records.

UserMigrationArn.Description: Stage 3: migration Lambda ARN for the email-only pool; blank keeps the trigger disconnected.

GoogleProviderSecretArn.Description: Optional existing secret JSON client_id/client_secret. Blank disables Google.

AppleProviderSecretArn.Description: Optional existing secret JSON client_id/team_id/key_id/private_key. Blank disables Apple.

WebhookBufferStackName.Description: Existing webhook-buffer stack; blank grants no webhook buffer access

CognitoSesIdentityArn.Description: Verified Seoul SES identity ARN; enable only after production sending approval

CognitoSesFromEmail.Description: Verified sender email matching the configured SES identity

WebDomainAliases.Description: Optional comma-separated exact lowercase viewer domains including WebDomainName; blank keeps only WebDomainName

Assertions.AssertDescription: PostgREST needs an immutable image digest.
PostgREST needs a dedicated existing secret.
SES identity and from email must be supplied together
An explicit alias list must contain the canonical WebDomainName and no blank entries

Properties.GroupDescription: Web from public ALB; PostgREST from internal ALB only
PostgreSQL from environment task ENIs only

Properties.Description: CloudFront origin verification header for this environment

FunctionConfig.Comment: Replace untrusted forwarded host with actual CloudFront viewer Host
